title: trackerHostResourceHold
responsibility: Decides whether a computer's RAM, disk, inode and load readings allow another Tracker session, and says why when they do not.

inputs.name: trackerHostResourceHold.resources
inputs.description: Readings for the computer that would run the session.

inputs.name: trackerHostResourceHold.request
inputs.description: Computer name, whether the work is CPU budgeted, filesystems to check (home first) and configured minimums.

outputs.name: trackerResourceHoldPrefix
outputs.description: Start of every hold reason, used to treat a hold as a wait rather than a failed attempt.

outputs.name: trackerHostResourceHold
outputs.description: Prefixed reason for the first failed guard, or null when the launch may proceed.
